messages.subject: Re: [RBigData] error with as.ddmatrix in pbdDMAT 0.4-0
messages.body_plain:
Hi Drew,

I'm having the same exact problem as Christopher Paciorek. I'm using Ubuntu 12.04 with R 3.1.2 and pbdDMAT_0.4-0 , pbdMPI_0.3-1,  pbdBASE_0.4-3 recently installed from CRAN. I searched in github but  only found an earlier version of pbdBASE 0.4-2. Will I get the problem solved by installing this version?

Thanx!! and congrats to the pbd team for your work.
Joan

On Tuesday, March 1, 2016 at 2:15:05 AM UTC+1, Drew Schmidt wrote:

> Sorry, I should have been more clear.  The error is in pbdBASE.
>
> -Drew
>
> On 02/29/2016 08:10 PM, Christopher Paciorek wrote:

> > Hmm, I just tried installing as follows and got the same error:
> >
> > git clone https://github.com/wrathematics/pbdDMAT
> > R CMD build pbdDMAT
> > R CMD INSTALL pbdDMAT_0.4-1.tar.gz
> >
> > (RBigData/pbdDMAT is still numbered 0.4-0)
> >
> > This is with the other pbd packages still being their CRAN versions.
> >
> > -Chris
> >
> > On Friday, February 26, 2016 at 6:09:39 PM UTC-8, Drew Schmidt wrote:
> > > Hi Chris,
> > >
> > > Sorry about that.  We had to last minute deprecate a feature before the
> > > CRAN release, and my tests weren't running to catch the bug.  It's been
> > > fixed on github, but we're waiting out the clock to not violate the "1-2
> > > month" CRAN policy on updates.
> > >
> > > Thanks
> > > -Drew
> > >
> > > On 02/26/2016 08:35 PM, Chris Paciorek wrote:
> > > > So this wasn't happening an earlier version of pbdDMAT (I think I was
> > > > using 0.2-3 most recently before upgrading).
> > > >
> > > > Calls to as.ddmatrix (including just running the example code from
> > > > help(as.ddmatrix)) are giving this:
> > > >
> > > > ===============================
> > > > Using 2x1 for the default grid size
> > > >
> > > > Error in base.rpdgemr2d(x = dx@Data, descx = descx, descy = descy) :
> > > >    object 'ret' not found
> > > > Calls: as.ddmatrix ... .local -> distribute -> dmat.reblock -> base.rpdgemr2d
> > > > Execution halted
> > > >
> > > > ===============================
> > > >
> > > > This is on Ubuntu 14.04 with current pbdDMAT and dependencies
> > > > installed off CRAN. Also occurs on Scientific Linux 6.6.
> > > >
> > >

messages.body_plain:
Hi Joan,

The latest development version should solve that, and several other problems. There's no github tag release for it, but if you just grab the latest, it should work.

I hope to get these updates to CRAN soon, but I'm being pulled many directions at the moment. But it's on my short term agenda.

Thanks
-Drew
